The key stays on this phone, locked by its security chip. Only your fingerprint or screen lock opens it.

It starts working on %1$s. Check that the phone\'s date is right.
This key is too old to sign
It\'s a GOST 2004 key. NCA no longer confirms the time of its signatures, so documents signed with it aren\'t accepted.
On egov.kz or in the eGov Mobile app, under “Get a digital signature”. It\'s free. Then add the new key here.
Get a new key on egov.kz before then.
It can\'t sign anymore. Get a new key on egov.kz.
Not valid yet. Check that the phone\'s date is right.
Get a new key on egov.kz.
Opens with your fingerprint and its password
To sign again, you\'ll need the key file and its password. The key itself stays valid: this only removes it from this phone.
Your documents stay on your phone
When you sign or check, only a short fingerprint of the document goes to NCA, never the document itself. Your key never leaves the phone. No accounts, no tracking.
